title: people-ops-manager-prep-q2-2026
content:
Purpose:
Quick notes for the upcoming 1:1 with my manager and for the Q2 performance check-in. Mostly a scratchpad - not polished.

Key context (30k ft):
- Been in role 18 months; focus areas: onboarding, L&D, recruiting ops automation, manager enablement.
- Headcount growth ramping: hiring 15 roles this quarter across eng/infra/product.
- Team change: we spun out a Recruiting Ops contractor to a new role (Mar) which freed up capacity but left a gap in offer workflows.

Top accomplishments (last 6 months) - concise bullets I want to own in the review:
- Reduced average time-to-offer from 27 -> 19 days for engineering roles by introducing templated offer flows + automated reminders (JIRA: JIRA-ONB-1287).
- Launched new manager onboarding playbook and 3 cohort sessions; manager NPS after 30 days jumped from 62 -> 78.
- Built a lightweight onboarding dashboard (Sheets -> automated via Looker export) that tracks first-week task completion; used by 12 teams so far.
- Piloted a peer buddy program for infra hires: early retention signal looks good (only 1 churn in cohort of 14, anecdotal high engagement).
- Enabled hiring panel standardization docs and a rubric to reduce bias; rolled out training to 45 interviewers.

Metrics / evidence to cite in convo:
- Time-to-offer (eng): 27d -> 19d (baseline Oct 2025 -> Feb 2026).
- Offer acceptance rate: stable at 88% (no regression after process change).
- Manager onboarding NPS (30d): 62 -> 78 (n=43).
- New hire first-week checklist completion: 84% avg vs 65% prior.
- Hiring volume: 15 reqs active this qtr (est 45 hires full year).

Challenges / areas I want help on:
- Offer workflow ownership gap after contractor left. Need to hire or reassign - my bandwidth is tight. Prefer to hire Recruiting Ops IC (L4) but will need budget approval.
- Need executive alignment on extending onboarding dashboard to customer-success and product teams (some cross-team data access questions). I want a small headcount for one data-ops project or a short-term contractor.
- Scaling group training: cannot keep running cohort sessions manually if hiring continues at this pace. Need coaching on whether to prioritize a recorded curriculum + certification vs. hire a L+D generalist.

Goals for Q2 (S.M.A.R.T style) - what I will propose for calibration:
- Goal 1: Reduce engineering time-to-offer to <=16 days by end of Q2 through 1) two-week offer form iterations, 2) automated hiring manager reminders, and 3) weekly triage with recruiting leads. Metric: median days to offer.
- Goal 2: Increase new-hire first-week checklist completion to >=90% across pilot teams by end of Q2. Action: automate reminders and integrate a checkbox in Slack/Confluence.
- Goal 3: Build manager enablement on interview calibration: create self-paced module + one live workshop; target 120 interviewers trained by EOY (Q2 milestone: MVP module + 40 trained).

Career / development asks I want to discuss:
- Interest in growing into a people-ops manager in the next 12-18 months - need exposure to P&L/headcount planning and a stretch assignment owning hiring forecasting across two orgs.
- Request sponsorship for an advanced HR analytics course or access to internal data training (20-30 hours). Will propose budget ~ $2k.
- Ask for biweekly skip-level shadow in cross-functional planning with product to learn roadmap-level staffing decisions.

Feedback for manager (deliver as 1:1 talking points):
- Appreciate continued visibility on exec hiring priorities - it helped unblock offer approvals last quarter. More lead time on org re-structures would be helpful.
- Need clearer decision path for approving short-term contractors for data ops work so I can move faster - current procurement takes too long.

Potential talking points / agenda for 1:1 (30-40 min):
- Quick wins recap (5 min): time-to-offer, manager NPS, onboarding dashboard growth.
- Ask for headcount decision on Recruiting Ops role (10 min): why we need vs cost.
- Data ops contractor ask (5 min): impact and timeline.
- Career planning / development (10 min): interest in manager role & concrete steps.
- Blockers & dependencies (5-10 min): procurement speed, executive alignment for org access.

Concrete asks / proposed wording for manager:
- "I recommend we open a L4 Recruiting Ops role to replace the contractor - expected ROI: reduce time-to-offer by ~2-3 days and free up ~8 hours/week of my time. Can we approve the req this quarter?"
- "Can we approve a short-term contractor (8-12 weeks) for data ops to get the onboarding dashboard to scale for CS/Product? Estimated cost $12k-18k."
- "Would you sponsor a stretch assignment for me to own hiring forecasting for Product & Infra for Q3 planning? I'll produce a forecast + risk register and present to leadership."

Notes / raw thoughts to refine later (scratch):
- Consider small experiment: move offer templates into an automated Notion page + Slack flow so hiring managers get a single 'accept offer' checklist. Might cut 1 day in hand-off.
- Buddy program: add retro at 30/90 days and track mentor engagement. Low effort and high signal.
- Ask: could hiring team leads commit to responding to offer steps within 48 hours? Might be an org norm ask vs process fix.

Examples / anecdotes for performance review:
- Hiring manager X reached out saying process felt "much smoother" after templated offer form; hiring manager time spent dropping from ~4h to ~1.5h per hire for paperwork.
- Peer feedback from Recruiting Lead: "Taylor has been the go-to for onboarding ops - consistently drives low-friction solutions and is responsive to urgent offers."

Open questions (to bring to 1:1 if time):
- How do you see the people-ops priorities shifting after Q3? Any heads-up on new org expansion?
- Any preference for me to pivot from hands-on execution to a more programmatic/managerial remit now?

Todo / next steps after 1:1:
- Draft req justification and ROI for Recruiting Ops L4 and share by Tue.
- Prepare one-pager for data contractor ask with scope and deliverables.
- Send calendar invite for stakeholder sync re: dashboard expansion.

Misc notes to self:
- Pull onboarding NPS raw survey (Confluence page CONFLUENCE-POPS-42) before meeting.
- Update dashboard adoption numbers and include a screenshot.

- end of scratchpad -

(Will iterate this into a cleaner manager-prep doc after 1:1.)
